projects.name: Mirilashvili
projects.brief: Track BOTH Michael Mirilashvili (father) and Yitzhak Mirilashvili (son). Any news published about either of them, in any language including Hebrew media.

projects.name: Channel 14 (Israel)
projects.brief: Israeli TV channel. ONLY worldwide/international references — coverage of the channel by non-Israeli or international press. Stories about the channel itself and its owners. Exclude routine domestic Israeli programming coverage.

projects.name: Kazakhstan
projects.brief: ONLY large Western outlets: NYT, Financial Times, Bloomberg, Reuters, WSJ, The Economist and similar. Politics and economics only. STRICTLY no sport. Discard anything from local/regional or non-Western sources.

projects.name: Amadea Yacht
projects.brief: Superyacht seized by the US Government, owned by Suleyman Kerimov. Any news about the yacht, its owner Kerimov, or US government/court decisions regarding it.

projects.name: Calin Georgescu
projects.brief: Romanian politician. Any stories regarding him, his trial, and his relevance in Romanian politics.

projects.name: Abdulaziz Kamilov
projects.brief: Uzbek politician, current Presidential Advisor on Foreign Policy. Any news about him.

projects.name: Morgan Ortagus
projects.brief: American diplomat, Deputy United States Special Envoy to the Middle East. Any news about her.

projects.name: Charles Kushner
projects.brief: United States Ambassador to France and Monaco. Any news about him.

projects.name: Alex Spiro
projects.brief: American attorney, partner at Quinn Emanuel Urquhart & Sullivan. Any news about him, about large clients he represents, and any court decisions in major cases he is handling.
